characteristic_patterns: Institutional header typically includes SR University (often boxed or centered) along with School/Department (e.g. School of CS&AI, Engineering, CSE, ECE) and campus/location cues when printed

Examination metadata block commonly lists Program (B.Tech/M.Tech/MBA/BBA), Exam Type (Mid-1, Mid-2, Re-Mid, End Term, Supply), Academic Year (e.g. 2024-2025, 2025-2026), Regulation (e.g. R20, R22, R24), Course/Subject Code, Course Title, Year/Sem, Duration, Max Marks, Date, and often Course Coordinator
Standard instructions such as 'Answer all questions', 'Answer any...', 'Each question carries...', or section-wise attempt rules
Structured academic questions numbered cleanly (e.g. Q.No. 1A/1B, Part A / Part B / Section A / Section B) with explicit marks column or per-question marks notation (e.g. [5M], 5+5, 10M, CO/BL tags)
acceptable_variations: Different regulations (R18, R20, R22, R23, R24, R25) and departments format headers slightly differently (single table, dual boxes, or compact text banners)
Mid-term / internal papers may omit Regulation or Academic Year or combine Section A & B without a separate footer page number
Multi-page question papers frequently place the institutional header only on Page 1 while Pages 2..N continue Sections, questions, or diagrams
Mobile photographs or scans may lack decorative borders or have slight perspective tilt while still keeping text and structure intact
suspicious_red_flags: Document mentions 'SR University' or labels like 'Course Coordinator' on a flyer, podcast poster, brochure, certificate, class notes, homework assignment, answer key, or random text page
Another university name (e.g., JNTUH, JNTUK, Osmania, Kakatiya, VTU, Anna University, SRM) appears alongside pasted SR University text
Subject title/course code contradicts the actual technical domain of the questions inside the paper
Declared total marks or question numbering is severely scrambled, nonsensical, or replaced by non-academic prose
